title: Void Swarm: Idle Survivor Beginner Tips for Your First Days
subtitle: Eight practical habits that make your first runs, and your first upgrades, count for more.
description: Void Swarm: Idle Survivor beginner tips for Android: how to move, which level-up cards to take, what to upgrade first and how to use missions and offline earnings well.
card: Beginner tips for Void Swarm: Idle Survivor, movement, level-up choices, early upgrades, missions and how to make the idle base work for you from day one.

faq.q: What should I upgrade first in Void Swarm: Idle Survivor?
faq.a: Start with the cheap base and hangar upgrades that raise Scrap production and run strength, then spend Research Points in the economy branch. Cheaper nodes pay back fastest early on, so buy what you can afford before saving for one big node.

faq.q: Should I use Auto Pick for level-ups?
faq.a: Auto Pick chooses cards for you with weapon synergy in mind and repairs at low health. It is handy, but picking manually while you learn teaches you which weapons and passives combine into evolutions.

faq.q: How do I survive longer in a run?
faq.a: Keep moving, never stand in the middle of a crowd, collect crystals when it is safe and build around two or three weapons instead of spreading thin. Evolve a maxed weapon as soon as its passive is ready.
